column2: The coffers of the temples are full, and the faithful are struggling against heathens and the servants of the Dark Gods. Perhaps we should provide some assistance.
Your righteous struggle against the heathens has not gone unnoticed. I have dispatched an envoy of the temple with sufficient funds to assist you.
One of the favoured children of the gods has been accused of kinslaying. This is clearly unfortunate. The temples will allow the sinner to do penance for absolution.
An emissary from [From.GetTitledFirstName] has reached us with a proposal. [From.GetTitle] will grant us absolution for our sins of kinslaying.
[From.GetTitledFirstName] has repented [From.GetHerHis] grave sin of kinslaying. Absolution has been granted, and the gods themselves rejoice.
[From.GetTitledFirstName] refuses to repent [From.GetHerHis] grave sin of kinslaying. [From.GetSheHeCap] will wait long and unforgiven at the gates of Morr...
I am forced to languish in this dungeon, where the evil fiends of [Root.Host.GetTitledFirstName] are torturing my soul.
We have received a letter from [From.GetTitledFirstName] asking us to intervene on his behalf and ask [From.Host.GetTitledFirstName] to release him from his prison.
We have caught [From.GetTitledFirstName] attempting to smuggle out a letter to the head of the faith, begging for intervention on his behalf.
The prayers of [From.GetTitledFirstName] have not gone unnoticed. Is there such a thing as a limit to my power?
[From.GetTitledFirstName] has come to our intervention and written a stern letter to [Root.Host.GetTitledFirstName] demanding our release.
A secret messenger from [From.GetTitledFirstName] has arrived, telling me that the head of the faith can do nothing to help me...
A letter has arrived from the head of the faith. It demands that we release [From.GetTitledFirstName] from our prison and submit to the will of the gods.

A procession of priests and temple guards has arrived at our castle, protesting that we are keeping a high priest of Myrmidia in our dungeon. They claim that we are sinning against the law of the goddess!

There are rumours that one of the faithful rulers of the Old World is employing a heathen in [Root.GetHerHis] council. This is not acceptable to the temples, and this earthly lord will surely be damned unless we intervene.

An emissary from [From.GetTitledFirstName] has arrived in our court. According to the emissary, the head of the faith is concerned about our employment of heathens as advisors, and asks me to remove them from their posts.
An emissary has returned from [From.GetBestName] bearing glorious news. The emissary says that [From.GetTitledFirstName] has agreed to banish a heathen that was in [From.GetHerHis] court.
Banish the heathen from our realm.
An emissary has returned from [From.GetBestName] bearing glorious news. The emissary says that [From.GetTitledFirstName] has agreed to imprison a heathen that was in [From.GetHerHis] court.
This is a day that has caused cries of joy to rise up from the Realm of Chaos. An emissary from [From.GetBestName] says that [From.GetSheHe] refuses to follow our demands.
An emissary comes from [From.GetBestName], with hopes of buying indulgences to cleanse [From.GetHerHis] sins. While [From.GetSheHe] has committed some very grave sins, this shows sincere regret.
The head of the faith has granted us absolution!

There are rumours that one of the faithful rulers of Myrmidia is employing a heathen in [Root.GetHerHis] council. This is not acceptable to the temples, and this earthly lord will surely be damned unless we intervene.

An emissary from [From.GetTitledFirstName] has arrived in our court. According to the emissary, [From.GetSheHe] is concerned about our employment of heathens as advisors, and asks me to remove them from their posts.
An emissary has returned from [From.GetBestName] bearing glorious news. The emissary says that [From.GetTitledFirstName] has agreed to banish a heathen that was in [From.GetHerHis] court.
An emissary has returned from [From.GetBestName] bearing glorious news. The emissary says that [From.GetTitledFirstName] has agreed to imprison a heathen that was in [From.GetHerHis] court.
This is a day that has caused cries of joy to rise up from the Realm of Chaos. An emissary from [From.GetBestName] says that [From.GetSheHe] refuses to follow our demands.
There is an errant priest in one of the realms of the faith. Rumours speak of him pledging allegiance to his earthly master ahead of the gods.
The head of the faith is most concerned about the loyalties of the priests of our realm. [From.GetBestName] asks us to replace one of them with a more pious priest.
An emissary has returned from [From.GetBestName] bearing glorious news. The errant priest is no longer in a position of authority.
Our emissary has returned from [From.GetBestName]. The news he brings is dire indeed, as [From.GetBestName] refuses to follow our demands.
We have loyal priests holding land in other realms. Perhaps we should return them to their rightful lords, so that they can guide their earthly lieges.
The head of the faith wishes to inform us that we will now also obey an earthly liege.
The head of the faith has granted you the [From.PrimaryTitle.GetFullName]. We will serve you faithfully as a vassal, and guide your rule in the way of the gods.

A somewhat unorthodox artist is working on what is clearly a statue of Ranald, God of Thieves and Luck. He asks for sponsorship, as it would make for an interesting and eccentric piece to display in our temple
A young artist is working on what is clearly a divinely inspired statue, depicting Morr, God of the Dead. He needs sponsorship to finish it, so we can place it in our own temple!
A young artist is working on what is clearly a divinely inspired statue, depicting Shallya, Goddess of Mercy. He needs sponsorship to finish it, so we can place it in our own temple!
A young artist is working on what is clearly a divinely inspired statue, depicting Verena, Goddess of Learning and Justice. He needs sponsorship to finish it, so we can place it in our own temple!
A young artist is working on what is clearly a divinely inspired icon, depicting Myrmidia, Goddess of Strategy and War. He needs sponsorship to finish it, so we can place it in our own temple!
I devote myself to the service of the Lady, and eradicating her enemies. I have not yet fallen to any of the mortal sins, nor do I shy away from danger. Honour is all, chivalry is all!
I am a fallen man. What was once a noble knight, is now just a mere sinner. I am not a true knight.
The [From.Religion.GetName] heresy has appeared in the province of [From.GetName]!
The unbelievers of [Root.GetName] are now a minority, and most of its people have embraced the [Root.Holder.Religion.GetName] faith!
The people of §Y[From.GetName]§! have embraced the §Y[From.Holder.Religion.GetName]§! faith!

[From.GetTitledFirstName], a preacher in the service of [From.Liege.GetTitledName], has arrived in [From.Location.GetName] to spread the word of their foreign faith. He has little regard for our old faith, declaring it sinful, and he has explained in detail the horrors we shall suffer in the afterlife unless we mend our ways.

[From.GetTitledFirstName] has continued preaching his religion in [From.Location.GetName], and he seems to be gathering a larger and larger audience. After listening to one of his sermons, you have to admit that the new faith may have some advantages...

[From.GetTitledFirstName] has fallen under the sway of [FromFrom.GetTitledFirstName] and the religion he preaches. After listening to the [FromFrom.GetTitle]'s sermons, [From.GetFirstName] has completely abandoned the old ways, and now only offers prayers to [FromFrom.Religion.GetRandomGodName].

You come upon [From.GetTitledFirstName] and [FromFrom.GetTitledFirstName] wrestling like children on the ground and screaming obscenities at each another. It would seem the two preachers have had a difference of opinion. As soon as they see you, they stop what they're doing and both immediately demand the expulsion of the other.

My liege, I have arrived safely in [From.Location.GetName] and the local ruler has given me permission to remain here and spread the true faith. May [From.Religion.GetRandomGodName] grant me the strength to endure the heathen ways of these savages...

Signed,
[From.GetTitledName]

Soon after [FromFrom.GetTitledFirstName] arrived in [FromFrom.Location.GetName], [From.GetTitledFirstName] ordered his imprisonment. Your [Root.GetLordSpiritualName] is now languishing in the dungeons of this pagan lord. Who can tell what the savages will do to him?

My liege, I bring good news! Thanks to my efforts, [FromFrom.GetTitledFirstName] has seen the light and converted to the true faith. I shall return to your court forthwith, as my work here is done.

Signed,
[From.GetTitledName]

My liege, I bring bad news. Although I seemed to be making progress in encouraging [FromFrom.GetTitledFirstName] to abandon [From.GetHerHis] heathen ways, [FromFrom.GetSheHe] had a sudden change of heart. I have been banished from [FromFrom.Location.GetName], and I say good riddance! Let these stubborn savages suffer the eternal horror that await them in the afterlife!

Signed,
[From.GetTitledName]

You have received word that [From.GetTitledFirstName] has been imprisoned by [FromFrom.GetTitledFirstName]. It seems the [FromFrom.GetTitle] took offense when your [Root.GetLordSpiritualName] converted one of [FromFrom.GetHerHis] courtiers away from heathenry.

My liege, that vile savage [FromFrom.GetTitledFirstName] has banished me from [FromFrom.GetHerHis] lands! I got into a minor... dispute with a preacher who was there to spread his faith at the behest of another lord, and [FromFrom.GetFirstName] foolishly took his side.

Signed,
[From.GetTitledName]
You come to blows with another cleric who has also come to [Root.Location.GetName] to convert the people to his own faith!
Send a temple envoy with funds
By the Gods!
The temples will allow penance for absolution.
I'm on my knees, praying for forgiveness.
Glory to [Root.Religion.GetRandomGodName]!
May the gods have mercy on [From.GetHerHis] soul...
Write a letter to the head of the faith
The high temple must be obeyed!
Slit his throat!
I can't keep a servant of the gods imprisoned.
Praise [Root.Religion.GetRandomGodName]!
[Root.Religion.GetHighGodName], why have you forsaken me?
I bend my knee to the high temple
Acknowledge their demands.
Demand obedience to the high temple!

Banish the heathen from our realm.
Glory to Myrmidia!
Glory to Myrmidia!

Send an emissary to have him replaced.
Follow the demands of the faith
Not to us, but to the gods be the glory!
The gods weep!
As above, so below.
Ok

May Ranald favour me!
May Morr guide my soul safely to the realm of the dead!
I pray to the Bleeding Heart for guidance
Kiss the Owl, praise Verena!.
Veneration of the Eagle is never bad.
I am Gilles!
May [Root.Religion.GetHighGodName] have mercy on my soul.
Horrible!
Praise be to [Root.Holder.Religion.GetHighGodName]!
Lost Souls!
There are horrors to suffer in this life as well, friend...
The time has come to embrace [From.Religion.GetRandomGodName].
The poison that preacher spreads ends here!
Side with [From.GetFirstName]. Banish [FromFrom.GetFirstName].
Best of luck.
Vile heathens!
Another heathen converted.
Very unfortunate.
That fool should be thankful!
That will cost [FromFrom.GetHerHim]!
Not in the face!
Our coffers are not that full
It is not our concern.
I am not repenting any 'sins'.
Pray for Divine Help
This is a secular matter...
The gods will judge us.
He is still a traitor...
I am [Root.PrimaryTitle.GetRulerTitle]!
Disperse the rabble.
It is not our concern.
Imprison the heathen!
[Player.Religion.GetPietyName] has its price, but this is really too much...

Imprison the heathen!

Ignore the emissary

I'm not falling for this.
This we cannot afford.

Tell us more of [From.Religion.GetRandomGodName].
No, the old ways are best! Banish the preacher!
To each their own.

I rule in my realm!
I rule in my realm!
I refuse to have any part in this petty quarrel.
[This.GetBestName] receives the money
will get a visit from one of our emissaries.

To the [GetFromRootCompliment] [Root.GetTitledFirstName],

Our Liege, the [GetRootFromCompliment] [From.GetTitledNameWithNick] has, in [From.GetHerHis] great wisdom, decided to adopt the [From.Religion.GetName] faith. As [From.GetHerHis] [From.GetLordSpiritualName], I would suggest that you consider doing the same.

In service of [From.Religion.GetRandomGodName],
[convert_lord_spiritual.GetBestName], [From.GetLordSpiritualName] of [From.PrimaryTitle.GetName]
Very well, I shall embrace this new faith!
